Interval.Name: Measurement interval (seconds)
Interval.Hint: How often each client measures its own latency against the server.

Hide.Name: Hide latency in the player list

Micro.Name: Compact mode (+ / - instead of ms value)

DiagTooltip.Name: Show jitter and estimated loss in tooltip
DiagTooltip.Hint: When disabled, the tooltip only shows the ms value.

AbyssTheme.Name: Abyss Link theme (dark manhwa)
AbyssTheme.Hint: Enables the dark/neon visual layer for Connection Guard badges, banners and panels.

AutoReconnect.Name: More aggressive auto-reconnect
AutoReconnect.Hint: Shortens the delay between reconnection attempts and forces a new attempt as soon as the network or tab become active again.

ReconnectMaxDelay.Name: Max delay between attempts (seconds)
ReconnectMaxDelay.Hint: Ceiling of the exponential reconnection backoff.

HistorySize.Name: How many drops to keep in history

DegradationThreshold.Name: Degradation threshold (ms)
DegradationThreshold.Hint: Average RTT above this value for consecutive cycles triggers a degradation alert.

DegradationCycles.Name: Cycles before degradation alert
DegradationCycles.Hint: How many consecutive cycles above the threshold before triggering an alert.

RouteProfiles.Name: Abyss Link extra routes
RouteProfiles.Hint: Optional. Paste one route per line or comma-separated. Example: softmisst.playit.plus:1051, 192.168.0.10:30000, 26.0.0.10:30000. The module always includes the current route automatically.

RouteScanTimeout.Name: Abyss Link timeout per attempt (ms)
RouteScanTimeout.Hint: Max time for each route test attempt. Higher values improve tolerance but make scans slower.

FailoverTimeout.Name: Failover timeout (seconds)
FailoverTimeout.Hint: Wait time after a connection drop before redirecting to the emergency Radmin route.

GmPanel.Name: Diagnostics Panel (GM)
GmPanel.Label: Open panel
GmPanel.Hint: Latency, jitter, estimated loss, drop history, degradation alerts and route matrix.

RouteOracle.Name: Abyss Link Route Oracle
RouteOracle.Label: Scan routes
RouteOracle.Hint: Compares GM-configured routes and recommends the best path for each player.

ServiceWizard.Name: Connection assistant
ServiceWizard.Label: Configure service
ServiceWizard.Hint: Choose the service used by the GM and configure only the selected route.

Menu.DependenciesNotReady: Connection Guard is not ready yet. Try again after the scene finishes loading.

ServiceWizard.Title: Choose connection service
ServiceWizard.Intro: First choose the service the GM is using to host Foundry.
ServiceWizard.NoWebRtc: This module configures only the Foundry route. Discord voice does not need STUN/TURN.
ServiceWizard.Invalid: Check the selected service, address, and port.
ServiceWizard.RedundancyHint: If the primary connection drops, players will be redirected to this Radmin IP.
ServiceWizard.InvalidRadmin: Invalid Radmin IP or port. Fallback was not enabled.
ServiceWizard.ReadinessWarning: Automatic failover requires each client to have network access to the configured Radmin VPN host. Connection Guard cannot configure Radmin VPN or operating-system firewall rules automatically.
ServiceWizard.ReadinessCheck2: Host connected to the Radmin network
ServiceWizard.ReadinessCheck3: Players connected to the same Radmin network
ServiceWizard.ReadinessCheck4: Foundry port open on the firewall
ServiceWizard.ReadinessCheck5: Radmin route tested by at least one client
ServiceWizard.CopyFailed: Could not copy the firewall command.

Requirements.radmin: Everyone must join the same Radmin network and allow the Foundry port through the firewall.
Requirements.playit: The playit.gg agent must be running on the GM's computer.
Requirements.ngrok: The ngrok agent must be running; the free plan address may change.
Requirements.cloudflare: cloudflared must be running on the GM's computer.
Requirements.local: Everyone must be on the same local network as the GM.
Requirements.direct: The port must be forwarded and allowed through the GM's firewall.
Requirements.custom: Confirm the custom address is reachable by the players.

Note.Radmin: Radmin VPN Free: every player must install Radmin and join the GM's network.

Service.SelectedNotif: The GM set the table's route: {label} click the chip on the edge of the screen to connect.
Service.ReloadHint: Open the link and reload Foundry to change route.
Service.GmOnly: Only the GM can set the table's active route.

Hint.Local: Local route: the Foundry host must be reachable on the same LAN.
Hint.Radmin: Radmin VPN: everyone needs Radmin VPN installed, connected, and in the same group. The 26.x.x.x range only answers inside the VPN.
Hint.Cloudflare: Cloudflare Tunnel: cloudflared must be running on the Foundry host with the hostname configured.
Hint.Playit: playit.gg: the tunnel must be active on the host with the port forwarded. Check the playit panel.
Hint.Ngrok: ngrok: the agent must be running on the host. On the free plan the URL changes on every restart prefer a static domain.
Hint.Direct: Direct IP: the public IP must be reachable and the port open on the firewall/router.
Hint.Custom: Custom route: check that the endpoint is up and reachable from your network.
